name: openbb_dividends
description:
Dividend history for one stock through the OpenBB Platform (obb.equity.fundamental.dividends).
Returns: {symbol, provider, data_points, truncated, dividends: [records with ex_dividend_date, amount and, by provider, record and payment dates]} or {symbol, error}.
Inputs (* required): symbol*; start_date; end_date; limit (rows returned, 1-1000; default 100; a dated series keeps its most recent rows); provider (fmp, intrinio, nasdaq, yfinance; default yfinance).
Other source: yf_dividends; upcoming market-wide: openbb_equity_calendar_dividend. Keys: nasdaq, yfinance need none; fmp uses SAJHA's FMP_API_KEY; intrinio needs a key in ~/.openbb_platform/user_settings.json.
Example: {"symbol": "KO"}

limit.description: Most rows returned (1-1000); a dated series keeps its most recent rows
